effects: The signer's USDT0 balance drops by `amount` and `recipient` receives exactly `amount`, with no fee (ERC20Upgradeable._transfer).
The call reverts if the signer is blocked or `recipient` is the token contract (TetherToken._beforeTokenTransfer).
formats.shown: Intent 'Send USDT0', with the amount in USDT0 and the recipient address.

findings.title: transfer limits recipient types to eoa, but the code lets contracts receive USDT0.
findings.evidence: descriptor transfer format, field 'To': "types": ["eoa"]; ERC20Upgradeable._transfer only requires recipient != address(0), and TetherToken._beforeTokenTransfer only blocks address(this).
findings.fix: Change the recipient types to ["eoa", "contract"], or remove `types`.

effects: Sets the signer's USDT0 allowance for `spender` to exactly `amount`, replacing the earlier value (ERC20Upgradeable.approve -> _approve).
formats.shown: Intent 'Approve USDT0', with the spender and the amount in USDT0, or 'Unlimited' at or above 2^255.

findings.title: approve has one test with 100 USDT0, so the 'Unlimited' threshold path is never tested.
findings.evidence: case 1 data amount 0x05f5e100 renders 'Amount: 100 USDT0'; descriptor approve field 'Amount' has "threshold": "0x8000…", "message": "Unlimited".
findings.fix: Add a test case that approves type(uint256).max and expects 'Unlimited'.

effects: Moves `_amount` USDT0 from `_sender` to `_recipient` (ERC20Upgradeable.transferFrom -> _transfer).
Uses `_amount` of the allowance that `_sender` gave the signer (the caller), via _approve(sender, _msgSender(), currentAllowance - amount).
The signer's own balance changes only when the signer is `_sender` or `_recipient`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Send USDT0', with From, To and the amount in USDT0.

findings.title: transferFrom uses the same 'Send USDT0' intent as transfer, so the use of an allowance is not stated.
findings.evidence: descriptor transferFrom "intent": "Send USDT0" is the same as transfer; ERC20Upgradeable.transferFrom spends `_allowances[sender][_msgSender()]`. Case 2 is named 'Send USDT0 from another account', but its screen intent is only 'Send USDT0'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Send USDT0 using an allowance" or "Send USDT0 from another account".

effects: Raises the signer's USDT0 allowance for `spender` by `addedValue`. The new allowance is the current allowance plus `addedValue` (ERC20Upgradeable.increaseAllowance).
formats.shown: Intent 'Increase USDT0 allowance', with the spender and 'Amount', which holds the increment in USDT0.

findings.title: increaseAllowance shows the increment, not the total allowance, because the total depends on storage.
findings.evidence: ERC20Upgradeable.increaseAllowance: _approve(_msgSender(), spender, _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue); descriptor field 'Amount' on #.addedValue.

effects: Lowers the signer's USDT0 allowance for `spender` by `subtractedValue`. The call reverts if this would go below zero (ERC20Upgradeable.decreaseAllowance).
formats.shown: Intent 'Decrease USDT0 allowance', with the spender and 'Amount', which holds the decrement in USDT0.

findings.title: decreaseAllowance shows the decrement, not the remaining allowance, because the remainder depends on storage.
findings.evidence: ERC20Upgradeable.decreaseAllowance: _approve(_msgSender(), spender, currentAllowance - subtractedValue); descriptor field 'Amount' on #.subtractedValue.

effects: For each index i, the signer sends `_values[i]` USDT0 to `_recipients[i]` through transfer (TetherToken.multiTransfer).
The signer's total outflow is the sum of `_values`. The arrays must be the same length.
formats.shown: Intent 'Send USDT0', with To and Amount pairs for each recipient, bundled per index.

findings.title: multiTransfer limits recipient types to eoa, but contracts can receive.
findings.evidence: descriptor multiTransfer bundled field 'To': "types": ["eoa"]; TetherToken.multiTransfer calls transfer(_recipients[i], _values[i]) with no EOA check.
findings.fix: Change the recipient types to ["eoa", "contract"], or remove `types`.

findings.title: multiTransfer does not show the total amount sent across all recipients.
findings.evidence: TetherToken.multiTransfer loops transfer over _values; the descriptor shows only the per-recipient amounts (case 5: 100 USDT0 and 50 USDT0).
findings.fix: None today: ERC-7730 cannot sum an array.

formats.key: permit(address owner_, address spender, uint256 value, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Sets the USDT0 allowance of `owner_` for `spender` to `value` after it checks `owner_`'s EIP-712 signature (TetherTokenV2._permit -> _approve).
Uses one permit nonce of `owner_`. The call reverts after `deadline`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Permit USDT0', with Owner, Spender, Amount (or 'Unlimited') and Deadline as a date. The signature parts are hidden.

findings.title: permit (v,r,s) tests only a 100 USDT0 value, so the 'Unlimited' threshold is never tested.
findings.evidence: descriptor permit field 'Amount' has "threshold"/"message": "Unlimited"; test case 6 uses a finite value.
findings.fix: Add a test case with value = type(uint256).max that expects 'Unlimited'.

formats.key: permit(address owner_, address spender, uint256 value, uint256 deadline, bytes signature)
effects: Sets the USDT0 allowance of `owner_` for `spender` to `value` after it checks the packed or ERC-1271 signature (TetherTokenV2._permit -> _approve).
Uses one permit nonce of `owner_`. The call reverts after `deadline`, and max uint256 means the permit never expires.
formats.shown: Intent 'Permit USDT0', with Owner, Spender, Amount (or 'Unlimited') and Deadline as a date. The signature is hidden.

findings.title: permit (bytes) renders a deadline of max uint256 as a date, but the contract docs say it means no expiration.
findings.evidence: TetherTokenV2 natspec: 'deadline … or max uint256 value to signal no expiration'; descriptor field 'Deadline' uses format date, encoding timestamp, with no special value.
findings.fix: Add a test case with deadline = type(uint256).max, and label the special value if the wallet supports it.

formats.key: transferWithAuthorization(address from, address to, uint256 value, uint256 validAfter, uint256 validBefore, bytes32 nonce, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Moves `value` USDT0 from `from` to `to`, using a signature that `from` made earlier (TetherTokenV2.transferWithAuthorization -> _transfer).
Marks `nonce` of `from` as used. The call works only between validAfter and validBefore.
formats.shown: Intent 'Send USDT0', with From, To, Amount in USDT0, Valid after and Valid before. The nonce and the signature are hidden.

findings.title: transferWithAuthorization limits types to wallet for From and eoa for To, but the code accepts any address.
findings.evidence: descriptor field 'From' "types": ["wallet"], field 'To' "types": ["eoa"]; EIP3009 _requireValidSignature uses SignatureChecker, which accepts EOAs and ERC-1271 contracts.
findings.fix: Change the types to ["eoa", "contract"] for both fields, or remove `types`.

formats.key: transferWithAuthorization(address from, address to, uint256 value, uint256 validAfter, uint256 validBefore, bytes32 nonce, bytes signature)
effects: Moves `value` USDT0 from `from` to `to`, using a signature that `from` made earlier (TetherTokenV2.transferWithAuthorization bytes variant -> _transfer).
Marks `nonce` of `from` as used. The call works only between validAfter and validBefore.
formats.shown: Intent 'Send USDT0', with From, To, Amount in USDT0, Valid after and Valid before. The nonce and the signature are hidden.

findings.title: transferWithAuthorization (bytes) limits From to wallet and To to eoa, but any address is valid.
findings.evidence: descriptor field 'From' "types": ["wallet"], field 'To' "types": ["eoa"]; SignatureChecker.isValidSignatureNow accepts EOAs and contracts.
findings.fix: Change the types to ["eoa", "contract"] for both fields, or remove `types`.

formats.key: receiveWithAuthorization(address from, address to, uint256 value, uint256 validAfter, uint256 validBefore, bytes32 nonce, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: The signer (who must equal `to`) receives `value` USDT0 from `from`, using a signature that `from` made earlier (EIP3009._receiveWithAuthorizationValidityCheck requires to == msg.sender; then _transfer).
Marks `nonce` of `from` as used.
formats.shown: Intent 'Receive USDT0', with From, To, Amount in USDT0 and the validity window.

formats.key: receiveWithAuthorization(address from, address to, uint256 value, uint256 validAfter, uint256 validBefore, bytes32 nonce, bytes signature)
effects: The signer (who must equal `to`) receives `value` USDT0 from `from`, using a signature that `from` made earlier (bytes variant, same checks).
Marks `nonce` of `from` as used.
formats.shown: Intent 'Receive USDT0', with From, To, Amount in USDT0 and the validity window.

formats.key: cancelAuthorization(address authorizer, bytes32 nonce, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Marks the EIP-3009 authorization `nonce` of `authorizer` as used, so a pending transfer or receive authorization with that nonce can never run (EIP3009._cancelAuthorization).
Moves no tokens.
formats.shown: Intent 'Cancel USDT0 authorization', with the Authorizer and the raw nonce as an optional field.

findings.title: cancelAuthorization shows the nonce only as a raw hash, which does not say which transfer it cancels.
findings.evidence: EIP3009._cancelAuthorization sets _authorizationStates[authorizer][nonce] = true; descriptor field 'Authorization nonce' has format raw and visible optional.
findings.fix: None: the nonce is a random id with no terms in calldata.

formats.key: cancelAuthorization(address authorizer, bytes32 nonce, bytes signature)
effects: Marks the EIP-3009 authorization `nonce` of `authorizer` as used, so a pending authorization with that nonce can never run (EIP3009._cancelAuthorization).
Moves no tokens.
formats.shown: Intent 'Cancel USDT0 authorization', with the Authorizer and the raw nonce as an optional field.
